name: Triggers
description: Wakes AAC when something happens in Home Assistant (an entity changes, an event) or at a time (reminders, routines), with your instruction. AAC can plan for itself here too: reminders, check-ins and things to watch, always noted under Auto.

own_plans.title: AAC may plan on its own
own_plans.help: Reminders, check-ins and things to watch that AAC sets itself (e.g. following up on something you want to achieve). It can never change your triggers, and every plan it makes is noted under Auto.

keep_chat.title: Keeps a chat
keep_chat.help: Each finding gets a chat of its own (you can answer in it). Off: only its entry under Auto.

chat_auto.title: Its chats go under Auto
chat_auto.help: Listed in the sidebar's Auto section instead of among your chats.
